meaning:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.30; also called Hurai at 1Ch.11.32;
Also named: chu.ray (חוּרַי "Hurai" H2360)
§ Hiddai = "for the rejoicing of Jehovah"
one of the 37 mighty warriors of David's guard

elsewhere.note: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.
